_comment: The worker's surface (docs/specs/execution.md). A worker is not an interactive session: it executes one decided ticket. It does not research (WebSearch/WebFetch), browse, or plan (wayfinder/to-spec/to-tickets/grilling/prototype/research) — a surface a worker cannot wander into is a worker that stays on its ticket. Loaded by conduct.mjs via --settings on the worker spawn line; deny rules apply from any settings source, trusted workspace or not.
